title: Force restart the Mac without graceful shutdown
summary: Restart the Mac immediately without waiting for applications to close or save data. Use this only if the system is frozen or unresponsive.

steps.explain: Run the reboot command with the quiet flag to skip the graceful shutdown process.
steps.expect: The Mac will restart immediately, potentially losing unsaved data.

rollback.explain: There is no command to cancel a forced reboot once initiated. You must wait for the system to restart.

warnings: This command does not save open documents or close applications gracefully.
Use only if the Mac is unresponsive, as it may cause data loss.
This command requires your administrator password.
